summary: Diageo plc filed a Form 6-K furnishing its Fiscal 27 Q1 trading statement for the quarter ended 30 September 2026. Reported net sales rose 1.2% to $4.93bn versus $4.88bn, with organic growth of 1.4% (0.6% excluding EABL); volume fell 1.1% organically and price/mix added 0.3%. Management reiterated full-year guidance. The release references ongoing EABL and Royal Challengers Bengaluru transactions only insofar as they affect leverage and free cash flow, providing no terms, price, premium, board recommendation or advisor. This is a routine periodic earnings update, not a special situation; watch North America softness and disposal proceeds.
